authority: Section 2 (the 10 base regimes, checked top-down, first match wins) and its hysteresis block. Thresholds are round textbook values registered as written and NOT fitted to any week (TA-193).
gating: DISPLAY ONLY. The label drives the card and nothing else. No cap, gate, filter, kill-switch or journal entry may be computed from it (convention 42, section 1).

hysteresis.stated_cost: Measured 1999-2026 (LAB b6a6abd9, ungraded): danger called about 2 sessions after a peak; recoveries about 80 sessions after a trough; the 200-day line alone about 38.
hysteresis.check: A history dry-run tests one property only: roughly 6 or fewer market-label flips a year. Never P&L.

feeds_absent_in_v1.vix: no raw VIX series. The Crash hard requirement (VIX above VIX3M on a close) cannot be tested, so row 1 is NOT EVALUABLE and is never read as 'not a crash'.
feeds_absent_in_v1.hy_oas_level: the credit factor is pinned at -1.0 and cannot show further widening; the spread LEVEL is a v2 feed.
feeds_absent_in_v1.brent: v2 feed; the oil and war keys need it.
feeds_absent_in_v1.carry_strip: the FX strip exists but is not wired into the evidence count.
feeds_absent_in_v1.rule: A family with no feed renders as NO DATA and is never inferred (R-IV.1193(d)).

families_v1.status: INTERIM, ratified R-IV.1198(e). Not final: section 2 names five families but states no per-family test, so these two reuse the Correction row's own clauses. Per-family tests are designed at the same review as the flip rate.
families_v1.structure: risk-off when SPY closes below its 50dma -- the Correction row's own first test
families_v1.breadth: risk-off when >= 2 of 3 indices (SPY/QQQ/IWM) close below their 50dma -- the Correction row's second test
families_v1.absent_rule: an absent family is counted neither way and never inferred; only row 1 counts families, and row 1 is NOT EVALUABLE in v1
families_v1.why_flagged: section 2 names the five families but v1 has no feed for three of them and no stated per-family test for the two it can measure, so these two reuse clauses section 2 already applies to the Correction row rather than asserting anything new
families_v1.flip_rate_review: R-IV.1198(c)+(e): the per-family tests and the flip-rate gap are reviewed together.
